Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the discussion earlier. Quick recap from our side and a proposed path forward so we can lock the technical deep-dive: 

- Key takeaways: integration via private VPC preferred; 1–2ms p99 latency target on critical routes; data residency (US) required for logs.
- Primary success criteria you mentioned: predictable per-request cost under $0.02 and a clear audit trail for access.

Recommended next step: a 60-minute platform deep-dive with our engineering and your security/procurement reps. Please confirm the attendees you want on the call (we typically include a solutions engineer + platform engineer + account executive).

I pulled a few windows that work for our eng team (attached as proposed-slots.ics). If none of these work for you, send three preferred times and I’ll align internally.

Attachments: RW-MAP-blue-sky-v1.pdf (draft mutual action plan), proposed-slots.ics

Proposed windows (Pacific TZ):
- Wed 05 May, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu 06 May, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Fri 07 May, 09:00–10:00 PT

Can you confirm which of the above works and who from BlueSky should join (security + procurement + platform contact)? Once I have names I’ll loop in our platform engineer and security lead.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett

laura@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
